summary: REQUEST_CHANGES on draft PR #300 head b5fcd1d1: the Rojo trust-boundary regression only counts the exact `src/server` mapping. A `ReplicatedStorage` mapping to `src/server/...` can expose server-only source while all current assertions still pass. Make the replicated-subtree check reject server-tree overlaps and add a leaked-subpath regression before integration.
evidence: tests/authority_rojo_boundary.luau requires the canonical `src/server` mapping under ServerScriptService and globally asserts countPath(tree, `src/server`) == 1.
The test never checks `$path` values under ReplicatedStorage for descendants such as `src/server/Bootstrap.server.luau`.

Adding such a replicated server-file mapping leaves the exact `src/server`, `src/shared`, and `src/client` counts unchanged, so the new regression would still report PASS while a server-only source file is intentionally replicated.
Review 4904140521 requests a subtree-aware overlap check and a mutated-project regression; it preserves the source-only evidence boundary.
